2440-3490-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2440-3490-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2440-3490-8095.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

549-4659-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-4659-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.
549-4659-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-7014-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

512-1129-2085.easyPrerequisites: Harabaz Druid and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-1129-2085.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
512-1129-2085.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Harabaz Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1129-2085.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Harabaz Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

141-997-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7524.easyPrerequisites: Rocket Volley must have valid targets.
1170-1636-4113-7524.description:
Cast Rocket Volley using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Maelstrom Artisan.
When Maelstrom Artisan enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1671-1993-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1671-1993-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

1274-6097-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-6097-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3175-7424.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

206-240-3967-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5921-5970-7297--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-7297--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5921-5970-7297--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

679-5437-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-5437-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

465-719-3742-4251-7175.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1308-4682-5140-5184.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-4682-5140-5184.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Xorn and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-4682-5140-5184.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2478-4195-4574-5243.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

869-1987-4423-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1395-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

1170-1645-2397-5954-6763.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2511-5258-5618-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
586-2511-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4875-4929-5365-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
4875-4929-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Cryptic Trilobite for additional mana.

2438-4484-4871-5643-6709.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
2438-4484-4871-5643-6709.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2438-4484-4871-5643-6709.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2034-3476-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

413-628-5405.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Soulstinger enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

656-2231-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

500-3227-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-3227-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Scrivener and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Scrivener tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

326-3926.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Eager First-Year triggers, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

876-2034-2703-4772.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

255-1908-3951.notablePrerequisites:
Stangg does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Stangg.
You control another legendary creature that can attack this turn.
You have a way to kill the additional legendary creature at instant speed.
255-1908-3951.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Éomer with haste.
Put all but the newest Éomer into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Declare Stangg and the additional legendary creature as attackers.
Stangg triggers, creating a 3/4 Stangg Twin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, kill the additional legendary creature.
When the creature dies, the Éomer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get at least one additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Éomer with haste.
Put all but the newest Éomer into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Declare Stangg as an attacker.
Stangg triggers, creating a 3/4 Stangg Twin creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Put either Stangg Twin token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 6.

283-4385-5231.notablePrerequisites: Illusionist's Bracers attached to Sliver Queen.
283-4385-5231.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Sliver Queen's ability.
Resolve both Sliver Queen abilities, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
